panels.title: Services Up
panels.description: Scrape targets currently up for the selected environment/instance.

panels.title: Services Down
panels.description: Targets currently down. Anything above 0 is a problem.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate
panels.description: Total HTTP request rate across all services (5-minute average).

panels.title: HTTP 5xx Rate
panels.description: Share of HTTP responses with a 5xx status (5-minute average), all services.

panels.title: P95 Latency
panels.description: 95th-percentile HTTP request duration (5-minute window), all services.

panels.title: Received
panels.description: Service orders received in the selected time range. Prometheus counter estimate — can be off by ±1 at low volume.

panels.title: Completed
panels.description: Service orders completed successfully in the selected time range (counter estimate).

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Service orders failed in the selected time range (counter estimate).

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Completed ÷ processed within the range. – means no orders were processed in the range.

panels.title: Orders Over Time
panels.description: Service orders received per time bucket.

panels.title: Received
panels.description: Resource orders received in the selected time range. Prometheus counter estimate — can be off by ±1 at low volume.

panels.title: Completed
panels.description: Resource orders completed successfully in the selected time range (counter estimate).

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Resource orders failed in the selected time range (counter estimate).

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Completed ÷ processed within the range. – means no orders were processed in the range.

panels.title: Orders Over Time
panels.description: Resource orders received per time bucket.

panels.title: Error Logs
panels.description: Error and fatal log lines in the selected time range, all services.

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: Warning log lines in the selected time range, all services.

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | environment=~"$environment" | cxo_instance=~"$cxo_instance" | detected_level=~"error|fatal" [$__range])))

panels.title: Errors by Service
panels.description: Top 5 services by error/fatal log lines in the selected time range.
Structured events (LogCxoEvent) in the selected time range: order dispatches, state changes, workflow tasks, job runs.
panels.title: Events

panels.description: Events with Status="Failed" in the selected time range. The CxO Events dashboard lists them with reasons.
panels.title: Failed Events

panels.description: Top event types in the selected time range, across all services.

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (EventType) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | environment=~"$environment" | cxo_instance=~"$cxo_instance" | EventType != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Events by Type

panels.description: Total unconsumed messages across all consumer groups. Should hover near zero; a sustained climb means a consumer is stuck or too slow.
panels.title: Total Consumer Lag

panels.description: Partitions whose in-sync replica set is short of the replication factor. Always 0 on a healthy cluster.
panels.title: Under-replicated Partitions

panels.description: Unconsumed messages per consumer group over time.
